summary: Text input that filters a list of violet-option children; use when the list is long enough to search.

usage.text: The value is the input text: after a choice, the option's label. The chosen option's value is the selectedOptionValue property (no attribute), and the form receives that; raw text is submitted only when nothing is chosen.

To choose from script call selectValue(optionValue), which fires a change event. Assigning the value property later changes only the text, not selectedOptionValue. An initial value may be an option's value or label.

Typing hides options whose label does not contain the text (case and punctuation ignored); with none left it shows "No matching options". Unchosen text is discarded on Tab, Escape or an outside press.

Choosing an option fires a change event with detail { value, selectedValue, label }. Typing fires input, and a native commit fires change, each with { value, selectedValue }; selectedValue is empty for free text.
The panel opens on focus, typing and arrow keys, and the open attribute reflects it. show() opens it; hide(commitSelection) closes it and, when passed true, resets the text to the chosen label.

a11y.text: Without a label attribute the input has no accessible name; the placeholder only names the popup list.
